author: Kyupity

title: Was reliable
body: Out of nowhere, tasks don’t reset after end of day. I have my end of day set to midnight, 0:00. But even after that time passes, tasks I have done the day before are still marked as done. Now I have to manually uncheck tasks of a routine to get a clean slate, messing up my records and defeating the purpose of a routine. Hope it gets fixed soon.

author: Tamadotchi

title: iPhone app good, Watch integration bad
body: The iPhone app is good, but Apple Watch integration could be better. On the Watch, there’s no option to move a task to the end, only complete or skip. Every day when I’ve already started a routine, the Watch app will suddenly end it and I’ll have to restart the routine on the app. I’m trying to stay off my phone and I was really hoping the Watch app would help with that, but I guess I’ll have to shop around more.

title: The app I’m looking for BUT
body: It was what I need, but it crashed. It just became stuck at one routine and I can’t end the routine. Developer issue it says. No movement as of now. So sad. I think I need to look for a replacement if they still won’t get it done before the sun sets.
author: chellie_rocher

title: Indeed the best productivity apps I ever tried!
body:
Alright soooooo I watched melotries on youtube and she featured this app several times on her videos. I immediately tried it since I want to fix my productivity and be more organized. I tried countless apps before but this app best works for me! I love how the app guides you what to do next so you won't feel loss everyday lol the feeling of the timer makes me want to accomplish my chores immediately and it's so satisfying everytime I check my every routines! I bought the premium subscription since I just had many routines I would like to fix for myself 😅

I'm the type of person who easily gets bored with an app but I can totally see myself using this app for few more years! I can't wait for more updates and features you'll add in the future 🥰

title: Feature Recommendation
body: I just wanted to recommend adding a feature of indicating if you’re done with a habit or not to move on with another one instead of putting a timer for each habit that automatically starts when the routine is started. Sometimes it’s just uncontrollable to take longer or shorter than usual.
